preflight.method: Actual writer reserve/finish/scalar calls and actual backing-buffer identities, plus returned prepared FULL/compact buffers. All originals restored before paired workloads. No global ArrayBuffer proxy.
preflight.allocationLimits: Counts cover the reviewed encoder backing stores, writer/DataView/typed-array objects, known subarray views and prepared objects. Byte capacities are cumulative per operation, not peak live memory, allocator overhead, all JS heap allocation, GC, RSS or wire protocol overhead. Prepared FULL capacity is already included in finish capacity and is not added twice. Car serializations are inferred from observed f32 calls: four per car and one per snapshot header.

concurrency.limitation: A cooperative lock cannot detect unrelated CPU/GPU work; the timing coordinator must arrange exclusivity.

scope.timedWork: One complete encoding broadcast over 12 captured cars and 0 recipients per iteration. Baseline uses actual encodeSnapshot with owning FULL flag set/restored; current uses the ordinary path at one recipient, and actual prepareSnapshotCars exactly once plus every encodePreparedSnapshot at multiple recipients. Zero recipients skip encoding. Includes writer allocation, growth, FULL/compact construction, recipient copies and every final finish copy; includes bounded output-ring writes.
scope.setupWork: Imports, independent identical seeded fixture/header construction, fixture ring, retained reference packets and output reference array are outside timing. Decoding, complete packet checks, ownership checks, hashing, allocation instrumentation and report writes are outside timing. The 32-fixture ring repeats; final outputs for every fixture remain observable.
scope.allocationScope: All allocations performed by production encoder calls remain inside timed run(), including once-per-broadcast prepared storage. Preallocated fixture/header objects and the fixed output-reference ring are outside timing. Allocation counts come from a separate untimed probe; no instrumentation is active in paired runs.
scope.limitations: Local synchronous encoder comparison only. Excludes world capture, header-object construction, server queue/event/dispatch handling, transport, MessageChannel delivery, command-log/resend selection, physics and rendering. Retains a bounded output ring, not every historical packet; preflight checks all fixture packets and later-call ownership. Zero-recipient timing is only loop/branch control overhead. No whole-game FPS, network-latency, heap/GC or device claims; report slower and no-gain cases.
